provenance.sourceSheet: SI1 - DPP LCI information.xlsx / X-Cell - CN
assumptions: RER regions are calculated with WE factors; GLO uses Global where available, otherwise WE.
Rows with no suitable physical-unit BONSAI factor are retained in the DPP but excluded from the main total.
Direct emissions are retained as inventory information; only fossil CO2 mass is reported separately, not added to the BONSAI process/object total.
Wastewater treatment is provided as sensitivity/excluded because SI2 marks it as an outlier with conversion factor 0.
The wafer row uses a rough M_ONMM proxy; a separate wafer DPP would be more defensible.
Direct emission rows are mapped to Biosphere3 vocabulary using SI2 - conversions used.xlsx, sheet emissions; they remain separate from the BONSAI process/object total.
Reference output is one discrete 210 x 210 mm PV cell; all inventory amounts and impacts were rescaled from the original 1 m2 cell-area inventory by 0.0441.
